device.name: New Era SyringeONE NE-1000 syringe pump (syrpp.SyrPump)

facts.text: A command is the pump address, the command code and its arguments concatenated and terminated with CR LF
The command table maps DIA, PHN, FUN, RAT, VOL, DIR, DIS, CLD, SAF, AL, PF, TRG, BP, OUT, IN, BUZ, VER, RUN and STP to the pump operations
DATA_RANGE gives phase 1-41, count 1-99, TTL level 0-1, timeout 0-255 and address 0-99
set_phase rejects a phase outside DATA_RANGE['phase'] before sending PHN
get_diameter sends DIA and returns the reply as a float; set_diameter sends DIA with the truncated number
PHASE_FUNCTION maps RAT/INC/DEC to rate/increment/decrement, STP to stop, LPS/LPE to loop start and loop end, and EVR/BEP to event reset and beep, among others
PHASE_FUN_DATA lists the functions that carry data: jump phase, loop count, pause number, if phase, event phase and output TTL
get_function sends FUN and returns the function name; set_function sends FUN with the function code and optional data
VOLUME_UNITS maps U to microliter aliases and M to milliliter aliases; TIME_UNITS maps M to minute aliases and H to hour aliases
get_rate sends RAT and splits the reply into a value and the trailing volume and time units; when they are not known units it returns only the value
set_rate sends RAT with the value and, when both are given, the volume and time unit codes
PUMP_DIRECTION maps INF to infuse, WDR to withdraw and REV to reverse
get_direction and set_direction translate through PUMP_DIRECTION
get_volume sends VOL and splits the trailing two characters into a volume value and a unit
get_volume_dispensed sends DIS and returns the infused and withdrawn volumes with one unit
get_status sends an address-only query and maps the prompt character to a status text
start_program sends RUN and stop_program sends STP
get_alarm and set_alarm use AL; get_power_fail and set_power_fail use PF
get_key_beep and set_key_beep use BP; get_buzzer and set_buzzer use BUZ
The pump address and baud rate are set on the pump manually before use
The package is tested on the New Era SyringeONE NE-1000 (distributed by Braintree as BS-9000)
The upstream examples address the pump at 0

operator_required.name: diameter
operator_required.reason: no text file of the clone states a syringe diameter range; the clone only truncates the number to four digits (src/syrpp/pump_conn.py:678-696). The installed syringe sets the bound, so the site supplies the accepted range.

operator_required.name: pumping_rate
operator_required.reason: no text file of the clone states a numeric pumping rate range; the syringe, the motor and the process set it. The site supplies the accepted range for its pump and tubing.
